data.text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY: MAJOR ROAD CLOSURES IN ABUJA THIS SATURDAY

Abuja residents, take note! The city will experience significant traffic disruptions on Saturday, 6th December 2025, from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM due to the International Half Marathon 2026 – Abuja FCT, organized by Premium Trust Bank.

Several major routes across the FCT will be temporarily closed to ensure the safety of athletes and smooth coordination of the event.

Key routes affected include:

* Mohammad Buhari Way
* Constitution Avenue
* Federal Secretariat Axis
* Shehu Shagari Way
* Murtala Mohammed Expressway
* Apo Roundabout stretch
* Nnamdi Azikiwe Expressway
* Area One – Galadimawa Roundabout Axis
* Ambassador Valentine Okereke Blvd
* Christopher Gwabin Musa Way
* Package A & B (Velodrome Area – FINISH POINT)

Traffic and security personnel will be stationed across the city to manage flow, but motorists are strongly advised to use alternative routes to avoid long delays.

If you’re heading out on Saturday, plan ahead, leave early, or avoid the affected corridors entirely.

Abuja, stay informed and stay safe! 🏃‍♂️🚧

Cc - @FCT_DRTS
#AbujaTraffic #FCTMarathon #AbujaEvents #TrafficUpdate #AbujaGist #StayAlert #AbujaTwitterCommunity
